## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Verification

List the automated tests and manual checks performed. State explicitly which
relevant checks were not run.

## Documentation

Describe documentation changes or explain why none are needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated work.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated for behavior changes.
- [ ] Relevant maintained documentation was updated.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, personal paths, runtime state, or generated artifacts were added.
- [ ] New or adapted third-party material is identified with compatible license and attribution information.
- [ ] Memory Engine or architecture-boundary changes update the corresponding architecture and code-map documentation.
